posts.text: 2023 to 26 is interesting. There is decrease in material cost by 5% but increase in OPM by 12%. Further, companies do need to pass-on some of the benefits of lower cost due to competitive nature of industries. So, Balu seems to be increasing its margins also with value addition along with lower raw material cost. More concerning thing is CFO even 33% of receivables are > 6 moths. Getting too many negative observations in this co. so avoiding.

posts.text: The CFO remuneration question is worth thinking more about. My guess is that as the company has been transitioning from a family-run business to a professionally run company, they will eventually change things. The key example is the hiring of COO Sadik Patel, who has long tenures at Bharat Forge, and then Happy Forging. In a 2024 investor meet, the management also mentioned that Sadik Patel joined with a team of 25 people selected by him.
